description: The installed npm package ships no tests/ directory, so shipped code never resolves a tests/ path at runtime. The one exception is bin/lib/http-mock.ts, which locates tests/fixtures/cassettes for offline replay in a source checkout and reports fixturesAvailable=false (the 'not shipped' refusal) when it is absent. Anything --dry-run needs ships under the asset root (templates/dry-run/corpus.json).
